jobs.description:
Bracco is an international Group active in the healthcare sector and a leader in diagnostic imaging. The Group’s main products are contrast agents sold in over 100 countries, both directly and indirectly through branches, joint ventures and license and distribution agreements.

Bracco Suisse SA, basée à Genève, est une entreprise du groupe international BRACCO (www.bracco.com), leader dans le développement et la commercialisation d’agents de contraste pour l’imagerie médicale. Le Groupe s’appuie sur deux centres de R&D, situés en Italie (CRB – Bracco Research Center) et en Suisse, qui associent expertise scientifique, savoir-faire et innovation. Notre centre de production, situé à Plan-les-Ouates, est approuvé et régulièrement inspecté par les principales autorités réglementaires internationales (FDA, Swissmedic, etc.).
Dans le cadre du remplacement de notre responsable HSE, nous recherchons pour notre site de Genève (Plan-les-Ouates) une/un:

HSE MANAGER (H/F)

Mission :
Rattaché(e) au Responsable du site, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la promotion d'une culture HSE forte, le respect des exigences réglementaires suisses et des directives du groupe Bracco, ainsi que dans l'amélioration continue des pratiques en matière de santé, de sécurité et de protection de l'environnement.
Vous serez également responsable du pilotage du système de management (SMI), conformément aux exigences des normes ISO 14001 (management environnemental) et ISO 45001 (santé et sécurité au travail).
En tant que référent(e) HSE du site, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la direction, les collaborateurs, les différents comités internes ainsi que les partenaires et autorités externes, afin de garantir un environnement de travail sûr, sain et respectueux de l'environnement.

Vos principales activités :

Hygiène, santé, sécurité et environnement

• Conseiller et accompagner la direction et les collaborateurs sur les questions HSE.

• Veiller au respect des exigences légales suisses et des directives du groupe Bracco.

• Identifier et évaluer les risques professionnels et environnementaux, définir et suivre les mesures de prévention.

• Superviser la gestion des substances dangereuses et des déchets, ainsi que la préparation aux situations d'urgence.

• Analyser les accidents et incidents, identifier leurs causes et coordonner les actions correctives.

Pilotage du système de management intégré (SMI)

• Assurer le déploiement, le fonctionnement et l'amélioration continue du système de management selon les normes ISO 14001 et ISO 45001.

• Coordonner les audits internes et externes et assurer le suivi des plans d'action.

• Maintenir à jour la documentation et les procédures HSE.

• Suivre les indicateurs de performance (KPI), établir les rapports HSE et contribuer aux revues de direction.

• Veiller à l'intégration des exigences HSE dans les projets et les activités du site.

Culture HSE et coordination

• Animer le Comité HSE du site et coordonner les actions qui en découlent.

• Développer une culture de prévention et sensibiliser les collaborateurs aux bonnes pratiques HSE.

• Organiser les formations et actions de communication en matière de santé, sécurité et environnement.

• Collaborer avec les équipes HSE du groupe, les partenaires externes et les autorités compétentes.

• Représenter le site de Genève dans les domaines HSE, avec l'accord préalable du Responsable du site.

Votre Profil:

• Formation universitaire ou qualification professionnelle équivalente. Le brevet Fédéral suisse de spécialiste en sécurité au travail et protection de la santé (STPS) constitue un atout

• Expérience confirmée dans une fonction HSE, idéalement dans un environnement pharmaceutique, chimique ou industriel

• Bonne connaissance de la réglementation suisse et des normes ISO 14001 et ISO 45001, une certification d’auditeur constitue en avantage

• Maîtrise des outils d'évaluation des risques, de prévention et d'amélioration continue

• Excellentes capacités de communication, d'organisation et de coordination

• Esprit pragmatique, proactif et orienté solutions

• Français et anglais courants, italien un plus

Ce que nous vous offrons :

• Rejoindre un site à taille humaine au sein d’un groupe international

• Une fonction clé au sein d'une entreprise internationale, avec un rôle direct dans le développement de la culture HSE du site

• Un poste varié associant responsabilités opérationnelles, conformité réglementaire et amélioration continue

• Des interactions étroites avec la direction du site, les collaborateurs et les équipes internationales du groupe Bracco

• L'opportunité de contribuer concrètement à la création et au maintien d'un environnement de travail sûr, sain et respectueux de l'environnement

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil et êtes à la recherche d'un nouveau défi, adressez-nous votre dossier complet (CV, lettre de motivation).

Contract type:
Permanent
If you meet the requirements of this opportunity and would like to join an international group working to improve patients' lives, apply now!
At Bracco, we believe in the values of diversity and inclusion. We respect and celebrate the diversity of our people and their experiences, ensuring a fair opportunity for all.
We are #Bracco #JoinUs

Bracco Suisse SA, con sede a Ginevra, è una società del gruppo internazionale BRACCO (www.bracco.com), leader nello sviluppo e nella commercializzazione di agenti di contrasto per l'imaging medico. Il Gruppo si basa su due centri R&D, situati in Italia (CRB – Bracco Research Center) e in Svizzera, che uniscono competenze scientifiche, know-how e innovazione. Il nostro centro di produzione, situato a Plan-les-Ouates, è approvato e regolarmente ispezionato dalle principali autorità di regolamentazione internazionali (FDA, Swissmedic, ecc.).
Nell'ambito della sostituzione del nostro manager HSE, stiamo cercando un sito a Ginevra (Plan-les-Ouates):

HSE MANAGER (M/F)

Missione:
Attaccato al Site Manager, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella promozione di una forte cultura HSE, nel rispetto dei requisiti normativi svizzeri e delle linee guida del Gruppo Bracco, oltre a migliorare continuamente le pratiche di salute, sicurezza e protezione ambientale.
Sarà inoltre responsabile della gestione del sistema di gestione (SMI), in conformità con i requisiti di ISO 14001 (gestione ambientale) e ISO 45001 (salute e sicurezza sul lavoro).
Come riferimento HSE del sito, lavorerai a stretto contatto con la gestione, i dipendenti, i vari comitati interni e i partner esterni e le autorità per garantire un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, sano e rispettoso dell'ambiente.

Le vostre principali attività:

Salute, salute, sicurezza e ambiente

• Consigliare e accompagnare la gestione e il personale su questioni HSE.

• Assicurarsi il rispetto dei requisiti legali svizzeri e delle linee guida del Gruppo Bracco.

• Identificare e valutare i rischi professionali e ambientali, identificare e monitorare le misure preventive.

• Superare la gestione di sostanze pericolose e rifiuti e la preparazione di emergenza.

• Analizzare incidenti e incidenti, identificare le loro cause e coordinare azioni correttive.

Sistema di gestione integrato (IMS) Pilot

• Assicurare la distribuzione, il funzionamento e il miglioramento continuo del sistema di gestione secondo gli standard ISO 14001 e ISO 45001.

• Coordinare gli audit interni ed esterni e monitorare i piani di azione.

• Mantenere la documentazione e le procedure HSE.

• Monitorare gli indicatori di performance (KPI), preparare i report HSE e contribuire alle recensioni di gestione.

• Assicurare l'integrazione dei requisiti HSE in progetti e attività del sito.

HSE cultura e coordinamento

• Per guidare il comitato HSE del sito e coordinare le azioni che ne derivano.

• Sviluppare una cultura della prevenzione e sensibilizzare le buone pratiche HSE tra i dipendenti.

• Organizzazione delle attività di formazione e comunicazione in materia di salute, sicurezza e ambiente.

• Collabora con i team HSE del gruppo, i partner esterni e le autorità competenti.

• Rappresentare il sito di Ginevra nei domini HSE, con il preventivo accordo del Site Manager.

Il tuo profilo:

• Formazione universitaria o qualifica professionale equivalente. Il brevetto federale svizzero per la sicurezza e la protezione della salute sul lavoro (STPS) è un bene

• Esperienza confermata nella funzione HSE, idealmente in un ambiente farmaceutico, chimico o industriale

• Buona conoscenza delle normative svizzere e degli standard ISO 14001 e ISO 45001, la certificazione dei revisori è vantaggiosa

• Conoscenza degli strumenti di valutazione del rischio, prevenzione e miglioramento continuo

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione, organizzazione e coordinamento

• Spirito Pragmatico, proattivo e orientato alle soluzioni

• Inglese attuale e francese, Italiano un plus

Cosa offriamo:

• Unisciti a un sito di dimensioni umane in un gruppo internazionale

• Una funzione chiave all'interno di un'azienda internazionale, con un ruolo diretto nello sviluppo della cultura HSE del sito

• Una posizione diversificata che combina responsabilità operative, conformità normativa e miglioramento continuo

• Interazioni ravvicinate con la gestione del sito, dei dipendenti e dei team internazionali del Gruppo Bracco

• L'opportunità di dare un contributo concreto alla creazione e alla manutenzione di un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, sano e rispettoso dell'ambiente

Se ti riconosci in questo profilo e stai cercando una nuova sfida, inviaci il tuo file completo (CV, lettera di copertura).

descriptionByLocale.en:
Bracco is an international Group active in the healthcare sector and a leader in diagnostic imagining. The Group的s main products are contrast agents sold in over 100 countries, both directly and indirectly through branches, joint ventures and licensing and distribution agreements.

Bracco Suisse SA, based in Geneva, is a company of the international group BRACCO (www.bracco.com), a leader in the development and marketing of contrast agents for medical imaging. The Group relies on two R&D centres, located in Italy (CRB – Bracco Research Center) and Switzerland, which combine scientific expertise, know-how and innovation. Our production centre, located in Plan-les-Ouates, is approved and regularly inspected by the main international regulatory authorities (FDA, Swissmedic, etc.).
As part of the replacement of our HSE manager, we are looking for one/one site in Geneva (Plan-les-Ouates):

HSE MANAGER (M/F)

Mission:
Attached to the Site Manager, you will play a key role in promoting a strong HSE culture, complying with Swiss regulatory requirements and Bracco Group guidelines, as well as continuously improving health, safety and environmental protection practices.
You will also be responsible for managing the management system (SMI), in accordance with the requirements of ISO 14001 (environmental management) and ISO 45001 (health and safety at work).
As the site's HSE reference, you will work closely with management, employees, various internal committees and external partners and authorities to ensure a safe, healthy and environmentally friendly working environment.

Your main activities:

Health, health, safety and environment

• Advise and accompany management and staff on HSE issues.

• Ensure compliance with Swiss legal requirements and Bracco Group guidelines.

• Identify and assess occupational and environmental risks, identify and monitor preventive measures.

• Supervise the management of hazardous substances and waste and emergency preparedness.

• Analyze accidents and incidents, identify their causes and coordinate corrective actions.

Integrated Management System (IMS) Pilot

• Ensure the deployment, operation and continuous improvement of the management system according to ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards.

• Coordinate internal and external audits and monitor action plans.

• Maintain the HSE documentation and procedures.

• Monitor performance indicators (KPI), prepare HSE reports and contribute to management reviews.

• Ensure integration of HSE requirements into site projects and activities.

HSE culture and coordination

• To lead the HSE Committee of the site and coordinate the actions resulting from it.

• Develop a culture of prevention and raise awareness of good HSE practices among employees.

• Organisation of training and communication activities on health, safety and environment.

• Collaborate with the group's HSE teams, external partners and competent authorities.

• Represent the Geneva site in the HSE domains, with the prior agreement of the Site Manager.

Your Profile:

• University training or equivalent vocational qualification. The Swiss Federal Patent for Occupational Safety and Health Protection (STPS) is an asset

• Experience confirmed in HSE function, ideally in a pharmaceutical, chemical or industrial environment

• Good knowledge of Swiss regulations and ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards, auditor certification is in advantage

• Knowledge of risk assessment, prevention and continuous improvement tools

• Excellent communication, organizational and coordination capabilities

• Pragmatic, proactive and solutions oriented spirit

• Current English and French, Italian a plus

What we offer:

• Join a human-sized site in an international group

• A key function within an international company, with a direct role in the development of the HSE culture of the site

• A diverse position combining operational responsibilities, regulatory compliance and continuous improvement

• Close interactions with the management of the site, the employees and international teams of the Bracco Group

• The opportunity to make a concrete contribution to the creation and maintenance of a safe, healthy and environmentally friendly working environment

If you recognize yourself in this profile and are looking for a new challenge, send us your complete file (CV, cover letter).

• Strong interest in digital learning technologies, AI, e-learning platforms, and content creation.

• Organizational and project management skills.

• Excellent communication skills in English.

• Exposure to international learning and development projects.

jobs.description:

Research and Development (R&D) encompasses a wide range of roles focused on the innovation, development, and enhancement of products, technologies, and processes. Contrast media injectors are safety-critical medical devices used in CT and MRI imaging. Verification of their performance is essential but remains largely manual, making testing time-consuming and prone to variability.

A robotic test system is already implemented and operational. The next step is to expand its capabilities: enabling it to autonomously execute test protocols, increase flexibility. This project focuses on advancing the existing robotic platform into an intelligent and configurable test automation system for contrast media injectors.

• Develop a flexible software framework to configure and run different test sequences.

• Expand the robot’s capabilities to cover additional test scenarios and edge cases.

• Quantify efficiency gains and reproducibility compared to manual testing.

La prochaine étape consiste à développer ses capacités : lui permettre d'exécuter de manière autonome des protocoles d'essai, accroître sa flexibilité. Ce projet vise à faire de la plateforme robotique existante un système d'automatisation de test intelligent et configurable pour les injecteurs de médias contrastés.

• Développer les capacités du robot pour couvrir des scénarios de test supplémentaires et des cas de bord.

• Quantifier les gains d'efficacité et la reproductibilité par rapport aux essais manuels.
